jobs_results.title: R&D Project Manager - Open-Source Software Cloud Platform
jobs_results.description:
For over a decade now, OpenNebula Systems has been leading the development of the European open source technology that helps organizations around the world to manage their corporate data centers and build their Enterprise Clouds.

If you want to join an established leader in the cloud infrastructure industry and the global open source community, keep reading, because you can now join a team of exceptionally passionate and talented colleagues whose mission is to help the world's leading enterprises to implement their next-generation edge and cloud strategies. We are hiring!

Since 2019, and thanks to the support from the European Commission, OpenNebula Systems has been leading the edge computing innovation in Europe, investing heavily in research and open source development, and playing a key role in strategic EU initiatives such as the IPCEI-CIS and the “European Alliance for Industrial Data, Edge and Cloud”.

We are currently looking for a Software Project Manager to come and join us... in Europe as part of our new team developing the next generation management platform for the Cloud-Edge Computing Continuum.

Job Description

As a Senior Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing and delivering successful IT projects, and helping run the company's strategic management framework. Your duties include ensuring that standards are upheld, directing the organization and scheduling of projects, and overseeing members of project teams to keep them on task. As a technology company, the position requires you have at least a bachelor’s degree in computer science engineering, or a related field, as well as prior management experience or experience with management of EU-funded projects (FP7, H2020 or Horizon Europe). The ideal candidate should have a strong background in international project management, with expertise in both Waterfall and Agile methodologies, and in Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and Balanced Scorecard (BSC) systems. Skills that are useful in your job search and throughout your career include leadership, the ability to direct a project with many different parts, and strong written and verbal communication. If you are passionate about open source and about driving technological projects to successful completion and thrive in a collaborative, international and innovation-focused environment, we encourage you to apply.

What you will do
• Managing a large international IT project from initiation to delivery, ensuring adherence to project scope, milestones, KPIs, timelines, and budget.
• Defining the standards for project's policies, processes and reporting, and make sure those standards are always met
• Monitoring the execution of projects using KPIs and OKRs, and its execution aligned with the development roadmap of OpenNebula
• Collaborating closely with development and engineering teams and stakeholders to define project objectives, requirements, and deliverables that meet use cases, collaborations and team needs
• Providing support to Work Package Leads to ensure their adherence to project scope, deliverable schedule, milestones, KPIs, timelines, and budget
• Utilizing industry-standard project management methodologies, including Waterfall and Agile (Scrum), to deliver iterative solutions that align with project goals.
• Communicating project status, progress, and risks to stakeholders, team members, and senior management.
• Coordinating project communication and dissemination in collaboration with digital marketing and community teams
• Identifying and managing potential project risks, issues, and dependencies, proactively implementing mitigation strategies to achieve project success.
• Utilizing management tools to track project progress, document project details, and generate insightful reports for analysis and decision-making.
• Acting as the primary point of contact for use cases, and corporate collaborators.
• Scheduling, managing and coordinating software releases.
• Contributing to the preparation of new project proposals.

What you will bring
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Software Project Manager or similar position
• Experience in managing research & innovation projects funded by the European Commission (FP7, H2020 or Horizon Europe) or by Member States
• Hands-on experience in managing or contributing to open source projects
• Ability to work in a matrixed and geographically diverse business environment.
• Strong leadership skills, including the ability to set goals and provide constructive feedback respectfully to build positive relationships and improve business results
• Ability to work effectively within a team in a fast-paced changing environment
• Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization and to interact with external stakeholders
• Multi-tasks, prioritizes and meets deadlines in a timely manner
• Strong organizational, planning, and follow-up skills and ability to hold others accountable

What's in it for me?

Some of our benefits and perks vary depending on location and employment type, but we are proud to provide employees with the following:
• Competitive compensation package and flexible remuneration: Meals, Transport, Nursery/Childcare
• Customized workstation (macOS, Windows, Linux)
• Private health insurance
• Paid time off: Holidays, Personal Time, Sick Time, Parental leave
• Afternoon-off working day every friday and during summer
• Remote company with bright HQ centrally located in Madrid; offices in Boston (USA), Brussels (Belgium) and Brno (Czech Republic); and access to office space near your location when needed. During the first year, for onboarding purposes, and for participation on certain projects, employees should be able to attend events and face-to-face meetings in our Madrid offices and be available to travel to Brussels and maybe other European cities. All employees are also required to attend our company-wide face-to-face all-hands meetings twice a year.
• Healthy work-life balance: We encourage the right for Digital Disconnecting and promote harmony between employees personal and professional lives
• Flexible hiring options: Full Time/Part Time, Employee (Spain/USA) / Contractor (other locations)
• We are building an awesome, Engineering First Culture and your opinion matters: Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued
• Be exposed to a broad technology ecosystem. We encourage learning and researching new technologies and methods as part of your everyday duties

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Lear For You

We work hard for the people who work for us. We champion our teams. We foster collaboration, inclusion, respect and excellence. What we are trying to say is we want to be more for you.

We are your path to a better career, a better future, and a better you.

Our teams have invented groundbreaking technologies, flawlessly manufactured millions of products and earned a long list of awards. Year after year, we are one of the World's Most Admired Companies.

Our teams are the secret to our success. They are empowered, inventive and inclusive. Passionate about their craft. Driven to succeed. Because we all understand that we must work together to win.

Are you ready for a better career? A better future?

We're Lear For You.

As a Project Manager based in Porriño (Spain) you will lead the delivery of multiple programs for the Structure division. You will lead global cross-functional teams that include sales, engineering, manufacturing, finance, quality and purchasing. You will... be responsible for program timeline development, documentation and execution ensuring scope, quality, timing and cost objectives are met.

Responsibilities:

• Lead cross-functional teams to plan and flawlessly execute programs that exceed both customer and internal customer expectations

• Taking responsibility for the program to ensure it is delivered on time, within budget, within approved profitability and required quality standards

• Planning and execution of all activities in accordance with milestones defined by the customer

• Management of product changes according to flexibility and costs defined/agreed with Engineering and Sales

• Identification of possible risks and critical points and application of necessary corrective measures by escalation in order to obtain the necessary support

Requirements:

• Higher education in engineering

• Experience working in the automotive industry and preferably in the field of mechanics

• At least 5 years of project management experience leading cross-functional teams both local and in highly dynamic environments

• Excellent communication skills

• Fluent in English and Spanish, French is an advantage

• Proactive, responsible, can-do attitude person and stress-resilient

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Job description

Tradebe is a multinational company where innovation meets environmental stewardship. We're on a mission to revolutionize sustainable solutions globally, we are in constant growth!

Therefore, we are thrilled to share our Leadership accelerator program. This program is designed to nurture and accelerate the leadership potential in individuals like you.

We are looking for a Project Manager for our Innovation Committee, and you'll play a crucial role in driving process improvement and innovation. Based initially in Barcelona, you'll later relocate to the UK.

The role
• Coordinate with plants to understand process improvement needs. Propose improvement and optimization projects.
• Search for public funding to develop R+D+it projects.
• State-of-the-art knowledge of new technologies and processes. Contact with technology centers and universities.
• Coordinating internal resources and third parties for the correct execution of the project.
• Ensuring that all projects are... delivered on-time, within scope and within budget.
• Ensure that all projects are delivered on-time, within scope and within budget.
• Developing project scopes and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility.
• Develop a detailed project plan to track progress.
• Use appropriate verification techniques to manage changes in project scope, schedule and costs.
• Report and escalate to management as needed.
• Manage the relationship with all stakeholders.
• Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation.

The person
• Great educational background, preferably in chemical engineering.
• Proven working experience as a project manager in the chemical or waste sector.
• Solid technical background, with experience in R+D+it.
• Good client-facing and internal communication skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multi-tasking skills.

We offer
• A challenging job in a fast-growing environment.
• A good working climate within a young dynamic team.
• A competitive salary.
• The chance to actively grow within our organization.
• You will work with the newest high-tech equipment on various projects.
• Working in an international company with the possibility to grow.

Do you think this vacancy is for you? Apply now, we want to meet you!

If this offer does not match your expectations, but you would like to develop your career in a company that promotes circular economy and sustainability, register on our Career Page. Don't miss out on new job opportunities!

Tradebe and Tecnoambiente are committed to guaranteeing selection processes based on merit and skills free of any bias based on age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or nationality. We believe in equal opportunities, and we work for it.

Please note Tradebe's Internal Career Opportunities Policy will apply.

EOE/M/F/AA/Veterans/Disabled

jobs_results.title: Implementation Project Manager - DACH
jobs_results.description:
At Kantox, we are looking for an experienced Implementation Project Manager to join our Implementation team in Barcelona.

This is an individual contributor position where your goal will be to effectively scope, plan and implement Kantox's Currency Management Automation software solutions with our corporate clients.

You will take direct responsibility for project scoping, planning, controlling progress, stakeholder management, and identifying and resolving risks and issues while providing an excellent customer experience and minimising time to revenue.

We are looking for a fluent Spanish and English-speaking candidate (Italian is a big plus) with a proven track record of managing software implementation projects with multiple customer stakeholders, a solid understanding of concepts related to business finance and currency markets, as well as enthusiasm for technology.

About the team

You will be part of the implementation team and work closely with the Sales, Customer Success... Product and Tech departments to help Kantox deploy its technology on a global scale.

We are a group of people with an international mindset - curious, explorative and open-minded. We enjoy leaving our comfort zones to reach new heights and push each other to bring out the best in ourselves. If you’re looking for a growth opportunity in a dynamic environment and look forward to challenging yourself, keep reading…

Your mission within Kantox

As Kantox grows, we are taking on larger-scale, more complex projects. We are looking for a proactive, collaborative and professional individual with solid project management experience, organisational and communication skills, attention to detail and an ability to work with multiple stakeholders simultaneously. We want someone who enjoys helping to build and improve our processes.

Reporting to Victor, our Product Implementation Team Manager you will be responsible for the following:
• Project Planning and Coordination:
• Working closely with C-Level stakeholders in the definition and implementation of their business strategy
• Assist in developing project plans, timelines, and milestones.
• Coordinate with team members to ensure tasks are completed on time.
• Monitor project progress and identify potential issues.
• Identify potential risks and assist in developing mitigation strategies.
• Communication and Collaboration:
• Facilitate communication between team members and stakeholders.
• Assist in conducting meetings and preparing meeting minutes.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project goals are met.
• Documentation and Reporting:
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation.
• Prepare regular status reports for project stakeholders.
• Assist in analysing project data.

Who you are
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Engineering, Business Administration
• 1-2 years of professional experience with the project management background.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills in English and German
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
• SAP knowledge is a big plus
• Proficiency in MS Office 365 (Excel and PowerPoint).
• Basic understanding of project management principles and project management tools/software.
• Professional fluency in Spanish and English, any other language is a plus.
• Attention to detail and resilience under time pressure.
• Deep curiosity for new technologies.

Our culture
• An environment of innovation, accountability, and constructive feedback
• A diverse and multicultural team of over 40 different nationalities
• Grow your role and build your career with our learning and development opportunities.
• A collaborative and inclusive culture of sharing and teamwork. Build connections for life.
• Hybrid working and flexible hours so you can work when and where you feel best
• Some testimonials: “The culture and the people at Kantox make me want to recommend Kantox as a place to work. There is a good balance between learning and growing and support from fellow team members. I feel like the people are very welcoming and make Kantox an easy place to feel at home."
What we offer:
• Competitive salary
• Sponsored learning budget
• Free private health insurance
• Free Spanish, English and French lessons
• Relocation package if needed
• Flexible working hours with an intensive Friday schedule
• Hybrid work model
• 29 days of annual vacations
• Gym discounts and free sport activities
• Restaurant Ticket with monthly credit and regular cross-team lunches
• Fresh fruit and unlimited coffee
• Beautiful office with incredible 360-degree views of Barcelona

About Kantox

Kantox is a leading fintech company developing sophisticated Currency Management Automation software solutions that help companies to automate their foreign exchange processes and leverage currencies for growth.

We are a 160-person strong team, split between London and Barcelona. So far, we’ve raised over €30 million and became profitable in 2018. Thanks to our clients, we continue to grow at a fast pace. Clients in 75 countries have already exchanged more than USD $18 billion with us!

As of July 2023, Kantox is a BNP Paribas company. Kantox will continue to operate as an independent company, now with the experience and market power of BNP Paribas behind it.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

Kantox is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion both in our hiring practices and in our experiences as a Kantox employee.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage all applicants regardless of race, religion, or belief (if any), colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, gender, gender identity, pregnancy and maternity, sexual orientation, age, marital and civil partnership status, or disability status

jobs_results.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Senior Project Manager - Renewable Energy - Northern Spain - 12-Month Contract

Do you want to work with a world leader in material technology? This opportunity is currently available to a Senior Project Manager to support our clients growing portfolio of projects globally across material science, chemistry and metallurgy.

With a portfolio of exciting projects coming up globally, there is no better time to join this exciting company – make your application today for immediate consideration.

Responsibilities:
• Execute the project within the agreed scope, planning and budget
• Guarantee alignment of the process and technological development
• Assure that all process and operations related aspects are covered
• Assure that technical requirements and capacity are met
• Assure the knowledge transfer into the operational organisation
• Define and follow up the progress of all the work packages required for the execution of the project
• Assure control and follow-up of all aspects of the... project by regular meetings and
• reporting
• Timely detect roadblocks and take corrective action to overcome them

Requirements:
• University degree, or equivalent qualification, in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Instrumentation/Automation

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Company Overview:

If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!

Flowserve is an American multinational corporation and one of the largest suppliers of industrial and environmental machinery, from pumps and seals to valves, actuation and instrumentation, to energy recovery devices and hydraulic decoking systems, and more, our products help plants overcome the... toughest flow control challenges.

The Project Manager will plan, direct, and ensure the successful outcome of projects utilizing the assigned project teams, as well as standards, practices, and toolsets established within Flowserve. You will work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure all project activity is regularly reported to the client and performed as per agreed technical specifications and project terms and conditions.

Responsibilities :
• Demonstrate ownership and accountability for total project execution, performance, and safety (project initiation to project completion) on all assigned projects.
• Drive improved customer relationships through creating a work environment that is free of unfavorable circumstances or perceptions for either party, that meets or exceeds performance expectations of the customer.
• Ensure a "clean order" before commencement of work on an assigned project and utilize the change management system to control the scope of work and associated cost, throughout the life of the project.
• Coordinate activities of all matrix reports (per Project).
• Responsible for managing spending expectations on each assigned Project.
• Communicate to all concerned parties project milestones, status updates, as well as any existing or potential customer escalation issues. Follow the right escalation processes and take overall ownership of all reports.
• Other duties as assigned.

Requirements :
• BS or BA Degree in relevant field (engineering) and 0-5 years relevant experience
• Proficient English skills
• Adaptability, flexibility, and proactivity.
• Excellent presentation, oral and written communication skills, including meeting and workshop facilitation experience
• Team building, problem-solving, and conflict resolution skills
• Experience using Microsoft Office.

Nice to have:
• Experience in program/project management.
• Proven experience in risk and change management
• Greenbelt, Blackbelt or Lean training experience preferred
• Rotating equipment experience
• Excellent estimating, scheduling & budgeting skills

What we offer (among other benefits):
• Canteen 100% founded by the company
• Transportation services 100% founded by the company
• Flexible working time: 30 minutes ahead or behind
• Summer timetable (shorter working hours)
• Easy access to the facility with city bus (line 283 from Avenida Americas)
• Easy access to the facility by car: close to M21 motorway junction

Req ID : R-9263

Job Family Group : Engineering

Job Family : EN Engineering

EOE including Disability/Protected Veterans. Flowserve will also not discriminate against an applicant or employee for inquiring about, discussing or disclosing their pay or, in certain circumstances, the pay of their co-workers. Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access flowservecareers.com as result of your disability. You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an email to employment@flowserve.com. In order to quickly respond to your request, please use the words "Accommodation Request" as your subject line of your email. For more information, read the Accessibility Process

jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Industrial Automation
jobs_results.description:
The future is what we make it.

When you join Honeywell, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers and doers who make the things that make the future. That means changing the way we fly, fueling jets in an eco-friendly way, keeping buildings smart and safe and even making it possible to breathe on Mars.

Working at Honeywell isn’t just about developing cool things. That’s why all our employees enjoy access to dynamic career opportunities across different fields and industries.

Are you ready to help us make the future?

We are currently looking for a Senior Program Management Specialist to join Industry Automation our team! The purpose of this position is to execute LSS Projects in Southern Europe region and based in Spain to deliver best in class solutions to meet customer expectations and within estimated financial performance. Lead the skills development, information sharing and project management discipline necessary to the deliver Projects in a... timely manner at planned gross margins or higher in the region.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Overall responsibility for managing Projects in Southern region from opportunity development stage to delivering the project successfully to customer.

· Ensures on time delivery of projects, within scope with zero or positive deviation.

· Maintains customer's satisfaction at acceptable levels and promptly resolves customer issues.

· Ownership for Projects financial performance. Monitors financial performance monthly and reviews estimates versus actuals to continuously improve Projects operational metrics.

· Effectively leads the implementation of productivity enhancing process changes related to project delivery.

· Responsible for driving costs down to be competitive in the marketplace.

· Controls cost and maximize productivity through the implementation of effective methods and standard processes.

· Drive Remote Migration Services for all Migration projects.

· Enhance utilization of GMSC for all Migration projects

· Ensures the availability of tools, equipment, and materials required while maintaining and controlling inventory levels. Ensures projects are resourced properly.

· Participate in estimate review process prior to jobs being quoted to ensure labor estimates are correct and that the work is achievable from a technical perspective. Ensure that subcontracts, where applicable, are complete and documented.

· Participate in material SIOP call with factory planners to provide forecast for Backlog and Front log project order demand to factory

REQUIREMENTS:

· BS degree or equivalent technical or management experience required.

· Thorough knowledge of handling LSS Projects field operations and financial processes

· The ability to demonstrate energy and determination to achieve results and improvement by overcoming obstacles, remaining effective despite setbacks, and challenging current thinking

· The ability to engage employees by providing relevant information in a timely manner using clear and compelling messages and by listening to and valuing input from employees.

· The ability to understand the implications and assess the appropriate degree of acceptable risk and take actions to minimize risk.

WE OFFER:

· A challenging international work environment.

· A competitive salary package with a variety of fringe benefits.

· Career development possibilities.

If this is your dream role, then we'd love to hear from you!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
Additional Information
• JOB ID: HRD223809
• Category: Business Management
• Location: Floors G, 1-3, LA CALLE MARÍA DE PORTUGAL,Madrid,MADRID,28050,Spain
• Exempt
•
